title: 夜明けのラジオと、桜色のモーニング
author: 春宮こより

en.title: Radio at Dawn and the Sakura-Colored Morning
en.premise: I work part-time at a slightly mysterious cafe that opens only during the quiet hours before dawn. Our signature offering is an exquisite breakfast set to be enjoyed alongside the melodies of the radio. As the worries and wishes of the townspeople drift in through the airwaves, they inspire our newest menu items. In the season of dancing cherry blossoms, this is a story of how delicious food and music gently soothe the soul.

zh.title: 黎明电台与樱色早餐
zh.premise: 我打工的地方，是一家只在黎明前静谧时光营业的、略显神秘的咖啡馆。这里的招牌，是伴随着收音机音乐一同享用的绝品早餐套餐！随着小镇居民们的烦恼与心愿通过电台传达，它们竟会幻化成一道道全新的菜单。在樱花飞舞的季节，美食与音乐将温柔地抚慰人心。
